resources.string: Write-only spatial touchpad gesture dispatcher for USB-C AR glasses (XREAL Air 2 Pro, VITURE Pro XR, Rokid Max, RayNeo Air 2s) in Google Pixel Desktop Mode. Does not read screen content or collect data.
Tuned for 240Hz batch sampling on optical see-through AR displays
Content tracks finger motion during 2-finger drag across the touchpad
1-finger tap for Left Click, 3-finger tap for Right Click
